rulerBands.Name: Range on the ruler
rulerBands.Hint: Shows the range band (short, medium, long, extreme) next to the distance measured with the ruler.

attackWarning.Name: Out of range warning
attackWarning.Hint: Before an attack or a spell, warns when a target is out of the weapon's or spell's range. The roll is never blocked.

farShotBane.Name: Automatic far shot
farShotBane.Hint: A target between one and two times a ranged weapon's range automatically gets 1 bane (core rules, ranged attack options). Beyond that, the attack is reported out of range.

Warning.OutOfRange: {target} is out of range of {item} ({band}, {limit} yd max): it is {distance} yd away.
Warning.FarShotPossible: {target} is {distance} yd away: far shot possible with {item}, with 1 bane.
